name: NCT
recent: 主要集资发展雪兰莪与吉打的工业园区项目。公司同时把收购 Semanja Murni 80% 股权的代价提高至 RM53m，并延长收购 NCT Marina Bay 51% 股权的条件期限。近期亦有多笔股份回购及董事相关股权交易。
notable: 936,639股新股（占已发行股本最多10%），集资发展 NSIP 与 NIS 工业园区项目。
并签署补充协议修改条款。
收购 NCT Marina Bay 51% 股权的条件期限延长三个月至2026年12月19日。
risks: 私下配售最多10%新股，可能摊薄现有股东持股。
董事在2026年9月2日间接减持共10,500,000股。
收购 NCT Marina Bay 的条件期限延长，交易尚未完成。
earnings: 2026年6月30日季度营收为 RM87.05m，环比下降10.6%，同比下降56.9%；净利为 RM20.50m，环比增长32.8%，同比下降16.7%；净利率为23.6%，高于上一季度的15.9%。

recent_en: NCT Alliance proposes a private placement of up to 10% new shares, mainly to fund industrial park projects in Selangor and Kedah. It also raised the consideration for an 80% stake in Semanja Murni to RM53m and extended the conditional period for acquiring 51% of NCT Marina Bay. There were also several share buybacks and director-related share dealings.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 304,936,639 new shares (up to 10% of issued shares) to fund the NSIP and NIS industrial park projects.
Proposed subscription of 80% enlarged equity interest in Semanja Murni for RM53m, with a supplemental agreement varying terms.
Conditional period for acquiring 51% of NCT Marina Bay extended by three months to 19 December 2026.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors indirectly disposed a total of 10,500,000 shares on 2 September 2026.
Conditional period for the NCT Marina Bay acquisition was extended; the deal is not yet completed.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM87.05m, down 10.6% QoQ and 56.9% YoY; net income was RM20.50m, up 32.8% QoQ but down 16.7% YoY; net margin was 23.6% versus 15.9% in the prior quarter.
